bounded live BioContainers lookup. Use a bare tagged reference without

name: Analysis
version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

  set -eu
  selected-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

representation.shell_command:
set -eu
python - "$(inputs.animals.path)" "$(inputs.fungi.path)" <<'PY'
import importlib.metadata
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import zipfile

importlib.metadata.version("phykit")

out = pathlib.Path("raw_pis.tsv")
with out.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    handle.write("group\talignment\tparsimony_informative_sites\ttotal_sites\tpercentage\n")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp_dir:
        for group, archive_path in (("animals", sys.argv[1]), ("fungi", sys.argv[2])):
            group_dir = pathlib.Path(temp_dir) / group
            group_dir.mkdir()
            with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as archive:
                names = sorted(name for name in archive.namelist() if name.endswith(".mafft"))
                if not names:
                    raise RuntimeError(f"No .mafft alignments found for {group}")
                for name in names:
                    archive.extract(name, group_dir)
                    alignment_path = group_dir / name
                    result = subprocess.run(
                        ["phykit", "parsimony_informative_sites", str(alignment_path)],
                        check=True,
                        capture_output=True,
                        text=True,
                    )
                    fields = result.stdout.strip().split()
                    if len(fields) < 3:
                        raise RuntimeError(f"Unexpected PhyKIT output for {group}/{name}: {result.stdout!r}")
                    handle.write(
                        f"{group}\t{name}\t{fields[0]}\t{fields[1]}\t{fields[2]}\n"
                    )
PY
